subject: Request: escrow-style trial credits + audit evidence for RFP bake-off
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@tidalhealth.ai>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@tidalhealth.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 17:12:00 -0400
Subject: RFP: bake-off logistics — credits + evidence ask

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the demo today. The evaluation committee is lining up three vendors for the bake-off and procurement needs a clear proposal for: 1) trial credits policy (how we escrow or disburse credits during the RFP), 2) basic compliance evidence (SOC 2 summary, data handling), and 3) an operations contact for any capacity spikes.

Two specific asks from legal/procurement:
- Can credits be placed in an escrow-style pool (so usage is trackable for the customer) and released on a per-stage basis?
- Can you share a one-page SOC 2 summary and a short note on data retention for inference logs?

We need answers by end of week to finalize the bake-off rules.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
Tidal Health

Attachments: Tidal-RFP-outline.pdf (referenced)

From: logan.wright@redwood.ai
To: Elena Park <elena@tidalhealth.ai>
Cc: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 18:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: RFP: bake-off logistics — credits + evidence ask

Elena —

Appreciate the clear asks. Short answers up front: yes to an escrow-style credit allocation; yes to providing a SOC 2 one-pager; and we can designate an ops point to monitor burst usage during the bake-off windows.

I want to propose a concrete flow so procurement has something to sign off on:
- Stage allocations: create a locked trial pool of 1M tokens credited to an escrow account tied to the RFP (visible to Tidal).
- Release policy: release 40% at stage 1 kickoff, 40% at stage 2 (feature/quality evaluation), 20% held for final verification or returned if unused.
- Measurement: usage slices exported daily (CSV) to a shared Drive; usage flags if per-minute QPS or token burn exceeds agreed guardrails.

Soojin — can you draft the short escrow terms and attach the SOC 2 one-pager? Neha — need your sign-off on the amount and whether we should add a modest discretionary top-up clause for infra spikes.

I can be the ops contact for the kickoff window next week but will hand off to Soojin for day-to-day monitoring.

Thanks,
L.

--
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Elena — following up with the draft materials attached. Highlights:
- escrow_terms: I drafted a 1-page "trial-credit-escrow-terms.docx" that maps to our standard pilot escrow flow (locked pool, staged release). It includes a short clawback definition and an accounting snippet for returned credits.
- SOC2-summary.pdf: high-level description of scope + where to find the full report under NDA.
- usage-slicing-sample.csv: example export format for daily consumption.

Elena — if that works, I'll convert the terms into a procurement-friendly language block and we can get procurement to initial the release points.

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, soojin.lee@redwood.ai, Elena Park <elena@tidalhealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: RFP: bake-off logistics — credits + evidence ask

Thanks team — reviewed the terms and SOC 2 summary. Approve the 1,000,000 token pool with the staged release (40/40/20) as long as procurement agrees to the visibility/export requirements. A couple of operational clarifications we should include before procurement sign-off:

1) Hit thresholds: if any vendor exceeds the agreed QPS or sustained token burn threshold (we suggest 150% of median for a 30m window), we trigger an ops review and Nebula (our throttle policy) may apply temporary caps until investigation completes.

2) Data handling: inference logs stored for 30 days by default; we can shorten to 7 days for this bake-off if Tidal requires. Please confirm desired retention.

Elena — if 7 days retention is preferred, state it and we'll bake it into the terms. Otherwise default is 30.

Once Elena confirms retention and the pool size, Soojin can produce a procurement-ready sheet for signature and I'll route the internal billing memo to finance.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference
